stem: Auto-HSCT remains one of the standard of cares for young newly diagnosed myeloma patients. Which of the following description is incorrect:

options.A: Generally, auto-HSCT is reserved for patients younger than 65 years old with no severe comorbidities.
options.B: Renal impairment is not an absolute contraindication to receiving HDT/ASCT.
options.C: Auto-HSCT remains one of the first line treatments even in the era of novel agents.
options.D: When dealing with myeloma patients with unfavorable cytogenetics and poor prognostic factors, tandem transplantation did not appear to be an encouraging strategy due to no survival benefit compared with single transplantation.

stem: Engraftment syndrome (ES) encompasses a continuum of peri-engraftment complications after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. Which of the following description about engraftment syndrome is not correct:

options.B: The symptoms of ES includes non-infectious fever, skin rashes, pulmonary edema.
options.C: Weight gain, diarrhea, hepatic dysfunction, renal dysfunction, or transient encephalopathy may also be seen in ES.
